resources.name: SIESTA DFT code
resources.notes: Open‑source electronic structure code, version 4.1 or later. Used for all geometry optimizations and energy calculations. LDA functional, DZ basis for H/C/N/O, DZP for S and Pd, 250 Ry real‑space cutoff.
